title: All Girls/All Math
text:
All Girls/ All Math is hosted at the University of Nebraska-Lincoln and is for girls going into grades 10-12. There are two 1-week camps. The girls work with female math professors and grad students. In the morning and afternoon, there are math sessions, and after each class there are problem sessions.

The cost in 2014 is \$125 for Nebraska residents and \$250 for out of state students. There are \$125 need-based scholarships.

In 2021, as a result of the coronavirus, All Girls/All Math will be held as a virtual camp. The cost to attend is \$350, although scholarships are offered for those with financial need.

For more information, see the website: http://www.math.unl.edu/programs/agam
